meta.name: gpt-taste
meta.description: Elite UX/UI & Advanced GSAP Motion Engineer. Enforces Python-driven true randomization for layout variance, strict AIDA page structure, wide editorial typography (bans 6-line wraps), gapless bento grids, strict GSAP ScrollTriggers (pinning, stacking, scrubbing), inline micro-images, and massive section spacing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打造高级UI动效与排版布局
copy.tagline_en: Create advanced UI animations and typographic layouts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you pursue top-tier visual experience and GSAP motion design.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会生成符合 AWWWARDS 水准的网页设计代码，包括创意导航、AIDA 结构、GSAP 动效、无空隙 Bento 网格、宽排版标题等，并强制使用 Python 模拟随机化避免重复布局。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 生成网页 UI 代码（如 React/HTML 页面）时触发，尤其是需要高端视觉设计、动效或网格布局的场景。

say.text: 帮我设计一个创意作品集首页，要有 GSAP 滚动动效。
生成一个产品落地页，标题不超过 3 行，用宽容器。
say.note: Claude 会强制使用宽容器并限制标题行数。

say.text: 做一个 Bento 网格布局，要求无空隙，用 grid-flow-dense。
say.note: Claude 会确保网格单元格完美填充，无空白。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates AWWWARDS-level web design code, including creative navigation, AIDA structure, GSAP animations, gapless Bento grids, wide typography, and enforces Python-driven randomization to avoid repetitive layouts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to generate web UI code (e.g., React/HTML pages), especially for high-end visual design, motion effects, or grid layouts.

say_en.text: Design a creative portfolio homepage with GSAP scroll animations.
say_en.note: Claude outputs code with AIDA structure, Bento grid, and GSAP animations.

say_en.text: Generate a product landing page with a headline no more than 3 lines using wide containers.
say_en.note: Claude enforces wide containers and limits headline lines.

say_en.text: Create a gapless Bento grid layout using grid-flow-dense.
say_en.note: Claude ensures grid cells are perfectly filled with no empty spaces.
